title: 'Days of Our Lives' Star Paul Telfer Celebrates Daytime Emmy Nod - NewsBreak
text: Tonight, the Daytime Emmy nominations began being released with various outlets releasing different categories. Among them was ‘Outstanding Lead actor in a Drama Series’ where Days of Our Lives star Paul Telfer earned a nomination. The actor has since taken to social media to share his gratitude and excitement. 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox The actor posted on Instagram saying, “What an absolutely lovely surprise ☺️ Huge thanks to the whole @dayspeacock family - and especially @ohmygodfrey [ Linsey Godfrey ] and @sscottthomas [ Serena Scott Thomas ] for being so amazing with me throughout the whole story with Xander’s mum. Forever grateful to work with these incredible performers who make me so much better at what I do Huge thanks to @carlivatiron [ Ron Carlivati ] for creating Fiona and giving us such great material to work with. And, of course, massive congratulations to my Days brothers @ericmartsolf [ Eric Martsolf ] and @gregrikaart [ Greg Rikaart ] - just an honor to be nominated alongside you both🫡” The actors co-stars quickly took to the comment section to share their support. “Ahhhh YES! You are so incredibly deserving of this 🥹 So so happy for you!” Cherie Jimenez wrote. Kristian Alfonso said, “Congratulations ! 🎉 🍾 🥳” while Al Calderon added, “PAULY 🔥🔥” Kennedy Garcia said, “Congratulations!!! So happy for you!” and the official Days of Our Lives Instagram account added, “Congratulations, Paul! 🎉💙” Fans took to the comment section to share their support for the actor, “In the current world where everything seems wrong, the universe (and Emmy voting panel) got this 💯 spot on correct!! So proud of you to have your exceptional talent and unparalleled hard work recognized again!” wrote one fan, while a second added, “Bravo, Paul!! Such a great story with Fiona, loved it, well deserved & fantastic work as always!💯❤️🔥” with a third sharing, “I'm so so so so so proud of you P 🤍🫶🏼🥹 you have earned this n have done such beautiful work portraying my beloved Xander - congrats my man n I'm definitely rooting for you” The actor previously earned a nomination for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama series in 2020. The Daytime Emmy’s will take place on October 17, 2025.
